description: Figma connector (read-only). Surfaces the files of a single configured team as figma:file items in the local index via a two-level fetch — GET /v1/teams/<team_id>/projects then GET /v1/projects/<project_id>/files for each project — capturing each file's name, project name, thumbnail url, and last-modified timestamp. Bearer OAuth auth (Authorization: Bearer <token>; short-lived access token refreshed by the Gateway via the 3-legged OAuth authorization-code flow; never logged); fixed SaaS host api.figma.com. Neither endpoint paginates with a cursor (each returns the full list), so the gateway-side syncable walks a single forward pass per cycle, project- and file-capped. Read-only — hitlRequired is intentionally empty. Sparse structured file metadata; the canonical url is constructed from the file key.
author: Nimbus
